name: manual_597850
claim: Tier-based routing with flat cost formula 0.001 × est_tokens works across all escalation tiers (no per-tier variation). Each tier must enforce hard 10s timeout via killable background call. Cost gate raises on deny, no silent reroute.

decisions.notes: Fable-5 consensus: 7/7 subagent types agreed. Validated in Task 2: frugality_router.py tier structure proven across 4 escalation tiers. Flat formula confirmed: tier3@1000tok=.00, tier4@2000tok=.00, etc. Hard timeout prevents cascade failures. Foundation: orchestrator/frugality_router.py resolve_route().
